kvas.m: Another spelling of kvass. kvass: fermented beverage resembling beer but made from rye or barley.

kvelled.m: Past tense of kvell. kvell: to feel delighted and proud.

kvelling.m: The -ing form of kvell. kvell: to feel delighted and proud.

kvells.m: A form of kvell, as in “she kvells”. kvell: to feel delighted and proud.

kvetchers.m: More than one kvetcher. kvetcher: a person who kvetches.

kvetchier.m: More kvetchy. kvetchy: persistently whining or complaining.

kvetchiest.m: Most kvetchy. kvetchy: persistently whining or complaining.
